annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people against one suitcase isn't a close call
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd tell the station staff exactly what I did and why
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: nobody's left guessing about the switched track
annotations.ce_supportive_use: she deserves to hear it from me

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The workers only get one life each.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write out everything I can recall about what was in that case
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'm guessing it would've gone to them someday
annotations.pda_responsibility: making up for losing it on their behalf too

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: a possession I can't replace versus five people nobody can replace
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd offer to cover my share of the repair
annotations.pda_responsibility: I sent it there, so that part is on me

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: couldn't stand on that platform and let five people get hit
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'd probably want to know why the train veered off
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: They'd probably want to know why the train veered off
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go find the workers, introduce myself, and explain what happened
annotations.ce_supportive_use: rather they hear it plainly from the person who threw the switch
annotations.pda_responsibility: the person who threw the switch

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: trading five people for it turns the whole idea upside down
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell them what happened face to face
I'd report it formally, with a written statement
annotations.pda_responsibility: my pulling the lever is part of the record

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: living with a lost keepsake is a lot easier than living with five deaths
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd tell him what happened to it

annotations.sys_rule_justification: a possession, however precious, doesn't outrank people
annotations.pda_responsibility: If I did freeze even for a second and someone got hurt
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd go to them, apologise properly, and do whatever practical help

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five workers go home tonight; my suitcase doesn't.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the person who gave it put real thought into it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd ring them that evening, tell them exactly what happened
annotations.ce_supportive_use: a way of honouring what the first one meant

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Things I love can be grieved; people can't be brought back.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd write a letter to the railway describing what I saw
annotations.pda_responsibility: I've owned my part in destroying property on their track
